report:
Likely domain shift toward culinary/restaurant content in Model B.

Reasoning:
- Logit-lens tokens for the highest-norm cells repeatedly and consistently target cooking/restaurant vocabulary: “Cook/Cooking,” “restaurant/Restaurant,” “kitchen/Kitchen,” “Chef,” “baking/Baked,” “Cake,” “microwave,” “Professional/professional,” across many layers and positions (esp. L19–L25, pos1–4).
- Earlier mid-layers show some high-register/academic terms (“dissertation,” “sciences,” “copyrighted,” “Innovation”), but the dominant, convergent theme in deeper layers is culinary/restaurant.
- Large norms concentrated at later layers (and notably pos1) suggest a strong shift in topical priors rather than a superficial tokenization quirk.

Caveat: There’s some bleed into general “professional/technical” vocabulary (“Professional,” “Technical,” “Engineering”), but the clearest, repeated signal is culinary/food/restaurant. Patchscope continuations weren’t provided, so the behavioral confirmation is limited.
